Indian Standard ( Reaffirmed 2002 ) 

SPECIFICATION FOR 
ELBOW COUPLING ASSEMBLIES FOR 
OIL-HYDRAULIC SYSTEMS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions and other requirements for elbow coupling assemblies 
used in oil-hydraulic systems. 

2. Types 

2.1 Type A — Covers the assemblies for taper male stud elbow bodies for sizes up to and 
including 18 mm. 

2.2 Type B — Covers the assemblies for male stud elbow bodies for sizes above 18 mm. 

2.3 Type C— Covers the assemblies for equal elbow bodies. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1. 

4. Assembly Details 

4.1 Type A — A taper male stud elbow coupling consists of ferrule (conforming to IS : 880<M!T8 
Specification for ferrules for oil hydraulic couplings), coupling nut (conforming to IS : 88C5-1978 
Specification for coupling nuts for oil hydraulic couplings) and taper male stud elbow LOdy 
[conforming to IS : 9387 ( Part I or Part II ) - 1979 Specification for taper male stud elbow body for 
oil hydraulic couplings ] as agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

4.2 Type ff — A male stud elbow coupling consists of ferrule (conforming to IS: 8802-1978), 
coupling nut (conforming to IS : 8803- 1978 ) and the male stud eibow body [conforming 
to IS : 9412 (Part I or Part II) -1980 Specification for male stud elbow body for oil hydraulic 
couplings ] as agreed to between the user and the manufacturer. 

4.3 Type C— An equal elbow coupling consists of ferrules (conforming to IS : 8802 - 1978). 
coupling nuts (conforming to IS : 8803- 1978 ) and equal elbow body [conforming to IS : 9388 
( Part I or Part II ) - 1979 Specification for equal elbow body for oil-hydraulic couplings ] as agreed 
to between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements— For details not covered in this standard, reference shad be made 
to IS : 8805 ( Part I ) - 1978 ' General requirements for ferrule type couplings used in, oil-hydraulic 
systems: Part I General '. 

6. Designation — An elbow coupling assembly Type A of light series L for outside diameter 
of tube 6 mm and conforming to this standard shall be designated as : 

Elbow Coupling AL 6 IS : 9411 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the j 
following standards : j

Elbow Coupling BL 22 IS : 9411 — B
